    Providing Solutions, Sustaining Ministries

    GCFA Requests Declaratory Decision

    on ¶ 404.2 of The Book of Discipline

    The General Council on Finance and Administration (GCFA) has requested a declaratory decision from the Judicial Council regarding ¶ 404.2 of The Book of Discipline. This request, supported by the leadership of the Interjurisdictional Committee on Episcopacy, seeks clarity to ensure faithful, consistent administration across the Church. Learn more about the request and next steps.

    Four Ways to Be Found: Building Your Church’s Online Presence

    Nov 12, 2025 01:00 PM Central

    Whether your church has a full website or none at all, there are simple ways to create a meaningful online presence. This webinar is designed for United Methodist churches and ministries looking to improve or establish how they’re represented online. We’ll walk through four key options—from leveraging the UMC’s Find-A-Church tool and using Facebook as your primary site, to partnering with third-party church platforms or building on platforms like Wix or WordPress. Join us to discover which option fits your church’s needs, tech comfort level, and budget.
